title: Mechanisms underlying the loss of anti-inflammatory activity in honey-processed licorice: a process-structure-function approach.
authors: Jing, Wenhui; Xu, Sijin; Li, Cunbing; Li, Yuxing; Li, Xiaoyun; Sui, Hong; Fu, Xueyan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蜂蜜炮制甘草中化合物经热加工后的抗炎活性丧失机制，虽涉及分子对接和动力学模拟，但核心是植物小分子与TLR4信号通路蛋白的互作，而非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Thermal processing strongly influences the bioactivity of phytochemical-rich foods, but the mechanisms behind functional loss under different conditions are not well understood. We used honey-processed licorice as a model to explore the process-structure-function relationship by simulating the honey processing of four key compounds: isoliquiritigenin, liquiritin, glycyrrhizic acid, and 18beta-glycyrrhetinic acid. UPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS, molecular docking, dynamics simulations, DFT calculations, and RAW264.7 macrophage assays identified a narrow processing window where moderate glycosidic cleavage creates an optimal pool of fragments, while extended heating causes over-fragmentation. These fragments, but not over-cleaved ones, maintain multi-target engagement along the TLR4-MyD88-TRAF6-IKK/IkappaB-NF-kappaB signaling axis through a conserved 'anchor-clasp' motif, explaining why raw monomers are more effective than honey-processed ones in macrophages. Our findings provide a framework for optimizing thermal food processing to preserve the health benefits of functional ingredients.
abstract_zh: 热处理显著影响富含植物化学物质食品的生物活性，但在不同条件下功能丧失的机制尚不明确。我们以蜜炙甘草为模型，通过模拟四种关键化合物（异甘草素 (isoliquiritigenin)、甘草苷 (liquiritin)、甘草酸 (glycyrrhizic acid) 和18β-甘草次酸 (18beta-glycyrrhetinic acid)）的蜜炙过程，探索过程-结构-功能关系。UPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS、分子对接 (molecular docking)、动力学模拟 (dynamics simulations)、DFT计算 (DFT calculations) 和RAW264.7巨噬细胞实验鉴定出一个狭窄的加工窗口，其中适度的糖苷键断裂产生最佳片段池，而延长加热则导致过度片段化。这些片段（而非过度裂解片段）通过保守的“锚-夹”基序 (anchor-clasp motif) 维持沿TLR4-MyD88-TRAF6-IKK/IkappaB-NF-kappaB信号轴的多靶点结合，解释了为何生品单体在巨噬细胞中比蜜炙品更有效。我们的发现为优化热食品加工以保留功能成分的健康益处提供了框架。
